response.overview: "Saving O Block" is a powerful documentary that delves into the lives of Pastor Corey Brooks and five teenagers enrolled in his program, Project Hood. Set against the backdrop of the rough Chicago neighborhood of Parkway Gardens, the film follows their struggles, hopes, and aspirations. Pastor Brooks, a tireless advocate for troubled youth, aims to provide a lifeline to those caught in the cycle of violence and poverty.
response.title: Saving O Block
